findings.message: CWE-22 MEDIUM opened at the prior verdict (27e5e787) is CLOSED at root cause in 630b02a6, verified with a passing regression seam
findings.detail_md: `_audit_dir(specs_dir, audit, *, fix)` in dadaia_workspace/features/specs/audit.py now resolves both `specs/audits` and the joined target with `Path.resolve()` and requires `target != audits and target.is_relative_to(audits)` before treating the target as a live audit directory. One rule confines `..` traversal, an absolute-path argument, and a symlink escape alike -- no per-shape check to drift. tests/integration/cli/test_audit_verbs.py adds three parametrized cases (`traversal`, `absolute`, `nested-traversal`) that plant a valid, fully-dispositioned audit OUTSIDE `specs/audits/` (so `close` would otherwise both archive and delete it) and assert the outside tree's `keep-me.txt` survives and the live audit's FINDINGS.jsonl is untouched after the refusal. Ran locally: 15/15 passed.
